figurative_meaning_bn: উপযুক্ত মিলন; যোগ্যের সঙ্গে যোগ্যের সার্থক মিলন
figurative_meaning_en: A suitable union; the successful matching of the worthy with the worthy
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাদের বিবাহ মণিকাঞ্চন যোগের মতো সার্থক হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Their marriage turned out to be a perfect match like Mani-Kanchana yoga.
The partnership between the two friends was a harmonious union.
note: Derived from classical Bengali poetic expressions emphasizing aesthetic and moral harmony.
